nom: Exfoliating Face Scrub with Monoi Oil & Sea Kelp

avis.texte: I was searching for a new scrub and came across this one. I decided to try it out because of the size and price. Well, definitely all worth it! I absolutely loved this! Just don’t go any higher in price! It wasn’t super coarse but not soft either. It was perfect. It got its job done. I had never heard of this brand and I’m glad to have taken the chance on it.

Obsessed with this cleanser. Literally reminds me of the beach—salt air and sand.. a clean scent and exfoliating scrub! I bought like 4 or 5 because i was afraid i wouldn’t be able to find it anymore!

Leaves my skin smooth and soft---without harsh particles! I'm 71 and have pretty good skin that I've taken care of. But occasionally it feels less-than-smooth, and I like to use a scrub. This one is amazing---my skin feels like glass, but it doesn't dry me out. It also doesn't tear my skin, like things with so-called 'natural' scrubbers (looking at you, peach pits!) will. I also use it on my chest and neck. My 'aging skin' doesn't need multiple times a week, but younger skin sure could!

I loved the scent and the feel of this scrub and so did my teenage son. The biggest downfall was how watery it is! We went through a tube of this in no time as it would just pour out! There was nothing you could do!

I’ve only used this a few times, but it seems to be a really mild spoliator. It is great for aging skin. My only problem is that it is very thin in consistency. It comes out fast and is not as thick as other products I have used. it definitely does the job!
Love this face scrub! Love how exfoliating it is!! Makes my face feel soft and clean!
Love this product. I have sensitive skin and this product never irritates my skin.
I love that this scrub isn't super abrasive. This is my seconding time buying.

Eh, this is a pretty big tube and felt really light in weight. I held it up to the light and its not even half full. The tube has not been used because I can see the opening security tab on it still. This is lying isn't it? Why wouldn't you either fill the tube all the way, or use a smaller tube? I deducted two stars for this reason. I've used this product for 2 years. I'll keep using it, but may purchase from a different supplier just to see if there's a different in the product amount. Great product, but some shady behavior at the very least. :/

avis.titre: "NATURAL" is a heck of a stretch!
avis.texte: FAR FROM NATURAL! While there are natural ingredients - IT IS NOT NATURAL! There are LOADS of dyes in here which I'm sure is why they didn't have the list of ingredients listed. Opened it, smelt great. Checked the back to see all ingredients and red, blue and yellow dyes all over the place. NOT HAPPY. Returning. AGAIN NOT NATURAL.
